confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge for a July 2026 window, which falls in Chiang Mai's rainy, lower-demand season. No web search or live listings were used for city prices. Food and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain and vary widely by room type, season and booking channel. The FX observation comes from a single RBA exchange-rate search and is separate from the anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city was used. Prices are placed below Bangkok and Phuket and roughly in line with other mid-sized northern Thai and mainland Southeast Asian tourist hubs, based on general regional knowledge.
